_template.purpose: Mutable canonical planning record, not a scheduler, implementation mandate, runtime state or product acceptance receipt.
instantiation: Replace every double-brace placeholder using placeholder_inventory; parse raw and substituted JSON with duplicate-key rejection. Rebase template-relative reference paths for the instantiated project location.

Unknown observations remain JSON null, never empty strings, zero, guessed timestamps, hashes, identities or success. Record their reason, consequence and resolution route in unknowns. Explicit absence or inapplicability needs a separate disposition and evidence.

False completion flags mean the new record has not established the gate; they are not negative observations about a provider or runtime. Empty collections are unpopulated until their inventory or completeness evidence is recorded, not proof that no findings, inputs or critics exist.

Collection shapes below describe records to append when observed, not synthetic rows to count as evidence. Record-shape nulls are unknown values; field descriptions and enum inventories are metadata, not runtime observations.

Use repository-relative immutable evidence path, SHA-256, revision and section bindings. Keep actual owner/chat/Run/Task/Dispatch identities, host paths, model routes and native receipts in private project bindings; no credentials or hidden reasoning.

Logis alone writes canonical planning state. The designated execution owner records accepted planning bindings in campaign state without a competing writer. Preserve revision history and event provenance; workers write only assigned artifacts and receipts.

Remove _template from the instantiated operational record after retaining this template's version/binding externally. This record's own hash belongs in an external receipt, never inside the file it hashes. Mutable planning state is excluded from the frozen planning manifest.

placeholder_inventory.campaign_name: English lowercase campaign slug; representative value sample-campaign.
placeholder_inventory.prefix: Unique short campaign artifact prefix; representative value demo.

_template.companion_policy: Absent or unaccepted companions are PENDING, not passed links or accepted schemas. Consume accepted owning references and the compact exact-hash packet, never changing sibling bytes. Final integration requires consistent fields, enums, authority/lifecycle/deadline meanings and zero missing links.
phase_rules: phase names planning activity only, not campaign lifecycle. Mandate, planning convergence, admitted execution, delivery outcome, pause and captain acceptance stay separate in their owning records. No fresh-session START ceremony or automatic fallback grants authority.

Sequence: intent and actual bounded repository discovery, live research and architecture, independent five-lens critique, then DAG and task decomposition. No PLAN/task files/native execution Tasks before the complete planning gate; prior capability exploration is not a DAG.

research.oss_library_evaluation_completed becomes true only after live-verified whole and partial OSS evaluation is written with registry/upstream or official stdlib evidence, licenses, adoption, maintenance, deprecation, security, footprint and dispositions. Logis updates planning state; the execution owner separately binds the same evidence in campaign state.

Required retrieval failure or unknown critical input blocks the affected path; preserve actual errors instead of inventing sources or substituting model memory. Artifact existence, a status label and author checklists cannot open a gate.

Only complete independent PASS from every required critic, with both exact current input hashes, all five lenses, owner-closed critical/major findings, all minor dispositions and no intent contradiction, may carry CONVERGED. Logis records the critics' attestation; it does not issue one.

The initial round inspects all five lenses. On revisions each critic owns affected scope, corrected and sibling defect checks, regressions, and explicit current-hash attestation for justified reused evidence. A bare unchanged assertion or old PASS is insufficient. Unknown required critics or incomplete inventory blocks convergence.

Planning severities critical and major block; minor requires resolution or explicit acceptance with rationale. accepted cannot waive a critical/major blocker. Each critic owns its findings and closure; preserve raw findings, author responses and all historical rounds.

Material intent changes return to intent/discovery; architecture or research changes return to research. Source/contract/evidence drift clears current convergence and DAG eligibility while retaining old verdicts/bindings. After freeze use an authorized new manifest and affected-scope review, never silent re-hashing.
The phase sequence requires the current gate even when phase says dag. A successful analysis report containing FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE never grants execution or product acceptance.
bound_rules: The scoped overnight amendment removes only the total campaign cutoff and supersedes stale two-paid-worker/fixed-cutoff prose. Another campaign must record its actual mandate rather than inherit these grants. Unknown cutoff disposition blocks admission; explicit absent_by_authority does not remove finite attempt/review bounds.

Persist original started_at, checkpoint_due_at and deadline_at before launch; actual launch observation may remain null while the prelaunch absolute deadline still binds. Fixes, retries, restarts, model/session changes, repeated reads, transport churn and late receipts never reset original clocks.

Before each affected dispatch, integration or gate completion, record actual UTC and compare the earliest applicable finite absolute deadline, authority, revision, pause, custody and exclusions. Refuse new affected work after expiry; do not infer permission from absent campaign cutoff.

At checkpoint inspect correlated semantic progress and allow at most one scoped steer if needed. Preserve separate observation, assistant, completed-tool and semantic-progress facts in runtime state; process activity is not progress or healthy evidence.

Use native result wakes and exact-owner deadline reconciliation, not shell polling, an external watcher or a mailbox consumer. Persist the next native event/one-shot receipt before waiting, then end the turn. A queued wake may be late and is not an exact-time enforcement barrier or proof of exit.

A specifically authorized native continuity backstop stays with the same owner, at most every 20 minutes here, does not duplicate dispatch, and disables at completion, pause or true needs-owner state. This JSON schedules nothing.

Expiry preserves partial work and stops admission, not automatically acceptance, permanent feature failure, kill or restart. Unknown launch/stop outcome blocks replacement and reuse; guarded settlement needs confirmed native custody/stop receipts. Operator pause never self-resumes; late output stays bound to its original revision.

At most two unproductive attempts, one slice defect-fix round and two feature-integration fix rounds under this mandate; useful findings do not create unlimited retries. Predeclared long phases cannot renew the original attempt. Unsupported spend controls need explicit bounded reconciliation, not invented flags or silently dropped limits.
execution_boundary: The amended provider is roborev, not a planning critic. Existing qualified host/container evidence is retained within its exact scope, not rerun as a bootstrap greeting or inferred as general engine/auxiliary parity. Document critique neither requires nor qualifies the code provider.

Do not duplicate runtime models or review runs here. The referenced execution record owns models.review_engine and tasks[].review.engine as roborev; models.code_review owns binary/version, independently resolved execution_engine, requested/resolved/actual model and qualification. tasks[].review owns run_id, raw_output, completion, coverage, findings, verdict and bound_to source/base/tip/scenario. Unknown observations stay null.

Each actual code candidate still needs a fresh neutral session, immutable no-hooks snapshot, source/test/dependency/packet/diff/config/tool-policy/hook guards, raw schema 3 JSON, sanitized provider stop/errors and tool results, and external complete file-to-tool-ID-to-line-range-to-returned-content/hash reconciliation. Roborev has no native coverage certificate; exit zero or ACP end_turn alone never means PASS.

Drift is INVALIDATED; missing, failed, partial, malformed, skipped, truncated, budget-stopped, unknown, unmappable or zero-required-coverage evidence is INCONCLUSIVE. Complete valid fail or critical/high/medium acceptance/security findings is FAIL. Only valid pass, full coverage, provider/tool success, preserved provenance and no blocking finding permit candidate PASS; low/style alone does not create fixes.

No routine second semantic code review, silent route change, installation or global permission/configuration change. Independent API inspection and real production-path runtime/integration evidence remain separate obligations.

After convergence, product successors depend on a separate native acceptance Task kept blocked, never made ready or dispatched. Only the designated coordinator completes it with matching exact-candidate independent review, required API, authorized integrated-source identity and actual post-integration smoke receipts. Document-only gates instead need assigned static evidence plus independent exact-byte document acceptance.

Review/integration/smoke bind repository/base/tip when applicable, exact source/test/dependency manifests, build/config and scenario version/hash. No-commit work preserves attributable diff, untracked source and starting/incoming/result manifests; never fabricate commits. Source/evidence and recoverability must survive before release; native settlement, exit and release are distinct.

At most three paid working agents and one source writer per worktree. One document or module plus tests per source assignment. Frozen previous-file review can overlap independent next-file writing, never review changing source; at most two related small files per packet with separate verdicts. Coordinators never write source or resolve source conflicts. Preserve replacement-node history; superseded nodes never become PASS.
collection_rules: Every *_evidence_id and each item of *_evidence_ids resolves to one unique evidence.id with immutable path/hash/provenance. Required null pointers or hashes and unresolved IDs prevent dependent eligibility. Private-record pointers resolve to independently evidenced custody/model/native records, not fabricated identities.

Each critique round has a positive round number, a frozen packet, both input snapshots/hashes and a separate required critic. With multiple critics preserve each response/attestation. critique.round, critic_identity, verdict and input_hashes summarize the latest response only; aggregate convergence depends on every required critic, never that summary alone.

Coverage rows use exactly intent_fidelity, architecture_and_research, security, ux, execution_readiness once each per critic round. Mixed mode identifies inspected and reused portions separately. Reuse requires prior exact evidence, critic rationale and attestation to both current hashes; initial rounds require inspected mode for all five lenses.

Preserve ordered historical rounds, finding ownership, raw responses and prior hashes. No findings, no intent contradictions and no unresolved blockers must be explicit evidence-backed conclusions, not inferred from empty or null collections.

before_launch absolute times and actual observations are distinct. All actual timestamps are aware UTC; unknown remains null. Hashes are lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of preserved exact bytes. No digest of this mutable file is stored in this file.

campaign_cutoff_authority.scope: Active full-auto campaign only; another campaign must replace this with its actual authority and cutoff disposition.
